records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quechua/docs%2Finstallation-reference.md#a-thin-profile-over-public-vocabularies
records.summary: Quechua keeps governance and trust concepts not already covered by public vocabularies; other concepts remain public terms with explicit pointers.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quechua/docs%2Finstallation-reference.md#shapes
records.summary: The repository ships opt-in SHACL profiles for Actions, Observations, work items and trusted knowledge records. Publishing shapes does not activate them.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quechua/docs%2Finstallation-reference.md#releases-and-pinning
records.summary: Immutable versioned Turtle assets and SHA256SUMS bind a release to its catalog version; the Pages copy follows main and is not a pin.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/quechua/scripts%2Fbuild-repository-share.py
records.summary: The repository-owned pendant builder uses the Bobbin indexer and Quipu share/import engine; publication policy stays on the trusted host.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quechua/docs%2Finstallation-reference.md#candidate-stable-namespace
records.summary: The installation reference records the registered Intigraph namespace and additive catalogs while preserving existing identifiers. Publication does not install aliases or migrate data; consumers must prove query and validation compatibility separately.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quechua/README.md
records.summary: Start with the repository README and current namespace links; distinguish published declarations from explicit consumer adoption.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quechua/docs%2Finstallation-reference.md#validation
records.summary: Use the pinned catalog, shape, trim and profile checks before changing vocabulary assets.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quechua/docs%2Finstallation-reference.md#releases-and-pinning
records.summary: Use immutable checksum-listed release artifacts for pinned consumers; publication does not activate policy.
